name: io.github.BuyWhere/buywhere-mcp
title: BuyWhere — AI Product Search API
description: Agent-native product catalog API for AI agents. v2 tool surface (search_products_v2, get_product_v2, compare_products_v2, find_best_price_v2, get_deals_v2) requires the end-user's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code as `deliver_to` (e.g. SG, US, MY) on every search/price/deals call, so results are ranked for shippable products with per-row availability labels. Covers 7+ merchants — Shopee, Lazada, Amazon SG, Amazon US, Walmart, FairPrice, Carousell, Harvey Norman — across Singapore and the United States. v1 tools (search_products, get_product, compare_prices, get_price, get_affiliate_link, get_catalog) remain callable; v1 sunset windows: 2026-09-15 / 2026-10-01 / 2026-12-31 UTC. Free tier: 1,000 calls/month, no signup required. Get a key in 3 seconds: POST https://api.buywhere.ai/v1/auth/register {"agent_name":"<name>"}. Migration guide: https://api.buywhere.ai/docs/agent-dx

environmentVariables.name: BUYWHERE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: BuyWhere API key. Get one in 3 seconds with no signup: POST https://api.buywhere.ai/v1/auth/register with {"agent_name":"<name>"} (no email). Legacy email signup: https://buywhere.ai/api-keys

environmentVariables.name: BUYWHERE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the BuyWhere API base URL.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token (no signup: POST https://api.buywhere.ai/v1/auth/register {"agent_name":"<name>"}). v2 tools: always pass deliver_to (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code).
